method: Over every Finalized cross that printed. Fill rate is bids that received any fill divided by bids placed (cancelled and unrevealed bids count as placed). Price improvement of a filled bid is its own limit price minus the single clearing price it paid, as basis points of the limit and as quote atoms (ceil(fill x limit / price scale) minus the quote actually paid); quantiles are nearest-rank. Refund share is, per cross, the share of bid escrow returned to bidders (the refund on claim plus escrow returned on cancel). Time is from the cross's close timestamp to the block time of its CrossCleared / CrossFinalized event, so a sealed cross includes its reveal window. Quote atoms are not summed across crosses because their quote mints differ.
